## Design note

The everyday R34: the same long-bonnet coupe shell and silky straight-six as the turbo cars, but naturally aspirated, on narrow 16-inch tyres and an open diff. It is no rocket, yet it balances nicely on the throttle and teaches the chassis the GT-T and GT-R share. Without the factory 180 km/h limiter it runs on to about 220 km/h.

## How this car breaks

90s Nissan HSS unibody with steel bonnet and wings and plastic bumper covers. The long straight-six sits well back, so light nose hits stay in the bumper and radiator; a hard frontal folds the rails into the engine. Narrow body, two big doors: side hits go straight into the B-pillar.

## Inertia

Box approximation about the CG, scaled for mass concentration (`k < 1`: mass near the centre, e.g. mid-engine; `k → 1`: mass at the ends):

```
I_roll  = k_r · m·(W² + H²)/12
I_pitch = k_p · m·(L² + H²)/12
I_yaw   = k_y · m·(W² + L²)/12
```

| roll | 553 | 0.80 | 440 |
| pitch | 2639 | 0.88 | 2320 |
| yaw | 2776 | 0.90 | 2500 |

## Engine

RB25DE NEO 2.5 L DOHC 24-valve I6, naturally aspirated, variable intake cam timing. Rated 147 kW (200 PS) @ 6000 rpm, 255 N·m @ 4000 [S8]. Naturally aspirated engines were not held back by the 280 PS agreement and period dynos match the rating, so the real-world factor is ×1.00. The curve shape is [E], fitted to those two points.

Peak **147 kW @ 6075 rpm**, **255 N·m @ 4000 rpm**. Idle 700 / redline 6800 / limiter 7000 rpm. Rotating inertia 0.16 kg·m² (class: 0.10 small four … 0.30 big-block). Engine braking 11% of peak torque = 28 N·m. Power-to-weight 106 kW/t.

## Drivetrain

FS5W71C 5-speed manual, open R200 rear differential. Layout **RWD**; front diff: open; rear diff: open. Clutch capacity 1.40 × peak torque = 360 N·m. Shift time 0.45 s.

| Gear | Ratio | Overall | km/h @ redline |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 3.59 | 15.67 | 50 |
| 2 | 2.06 | 8.97 | 88 |
| 3 | 1.36 | 5.94 | 132 |
| 4 | 1.00 | 4.36 | 180 |
| 5 | 0.82 | 3.58 | 219 |

Final drive 4.36, reverse 3.66. Speeds use the driven-wheel loaded radius 0.306 m.

## Suspension

Springs from ride frequency, `k = m_s·(2πf)²` with sprung corner mass `m_s = axle load/2 − unsprung`; dampers `c = 2ζ·√(k·m_s)`, ζ = 0.30 bump, rebound = 1.5 × bump.

| Axle | m_s | f | Wheel rate k | Bump c | Rebound c | Travel |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Front | 356 kg | 1.45 Hz | 29500 N/m | 1940 N·s/m | 2910 N·s/m | 0.15 m |
| Rear | 300 kg | 1.60 Hz | 30300 N/m | 1810 N·s/m | 2720 N·s/m | 0.16 m |

Anti-roll bars from a roll-gradient target of 3.0°/g with 56% of roll stiffness at the front. Roll arm h − h_rc = 0.372 m (roll centres 0.08 m F / 0.12 m R). Required total K_φ = m·g·arm/φ = 96829 N·m/rad; springs give k·t²/2 = 32318 F / 32746 R N·m/rad; bars supply the rest as `arb_n_per_m = K_bar/t²` = **10000 F / 4600 R N/m** (clamped at ≥ 0). Resulting gradient 3.0°/g, front share 56%. Bump stops 150000 N/m.

Alignment: camber -0.8° F / -1.2° R, toe +0.00° F / +0.15° R (+ = in), caster 5.5°.

## Brakes

Full-pedal line pressure 100 bar.

- Front: 280 mm disc, pistons per side 57 mm → A = 25.5 cm², r_eff = D/2 − 25 mm = 115 mm, pad μ = 0.38: T = 2·μ·p·A·r_eff = 2·0.38·100 bar·25.5 cm²·0.115 m = **2230 N·m**
- Rear: 292 mm disc, pistons per side 34 mm → A = 9.1 cm², r_eff = D/2 − 25 mm = 121 mm, pad μ = 0.38: T = 2·μ·p·A·r_eff = 2·0.38·100 bar·9.1 cm²·0.121 m = **835 N·m**

Lock check at 1 g on μ = 1 (load transfer m·a·h/L): front needs 1498 N·m/wheel (capacity 1.49×), rear needs 593 N·m/wheel (capacity 1.40×).

`wp_vehicle` gives the axle `bias_front` favours its full `max_torque_*` and scales the other by (1 − b)/b, so `max_torque_*` holds the caliper capacity per wheel and `bias_front` acts as the proportioning valve: the rear is trimmed to the same lock margin as the front (ideal rear = T_f · lock_r/lock_f = 883 N·m), never boosted above its caliper capacity. Rear capacity is below that (hardware-limited rear), so `bias_front` = **0.5**: both axles get full caliper torque → delivered 2230 N·m front / 830 N·m rear per wheel at full pedal. Handbrake 1440 N·m per rear wheel.

## Steering

Ratio 15.5:1. Kerb-to-kerb turning circle 11.0 m → outer-front path radius 5.40 m, rear-axle-centre radius 3.95 m → mean road-wheel lock δ = atan(L/R) = **0.593 rad (34.0°)** (outer 29.6°, inner 39.7° at full Ackermann; `ackermann_frac` 0.60). Rack speed 1.4 rad/s.
